arc.label: A Short Personal Arc
arc.heading: Experience matters only if it doesn’t stop you learning again.
timeline: 1980s — Started programming, because a machine that followed instructions was too interesting to ignore.
Later — Moved through several generations of technology, from small companies to large consulting environments.
Around 50 — Began running marathons; went from a first 3:24 to 2:57 by observing, modelling, experimenting, measuring and adapting.
Now — Building with AI while thinking more carefully about the human work that machines should never replace.

personalNarrative.label: Really About Me
opening: You can't leave a like here.
But perhaps you can leave a little bit of your heart.
Because you are a real human.
personalNarrative.decadeHeading: Every ten years, apparently, I need a new bad idea.

missingMan.heading: Missing Man.
missingMan.body: When I left a long project, I posted the missing-man formation from Goose's funeral. At night. Then I left the chat. I wanted the image to be the first thing they saw the next morning.

artifact.placeholder: Original Missing Man GIF — to be added.

missingMan.reflection: I learned what the missing-man formation meant afterwards. I just knew it was the image I wanted.

pizza.heading: Mortadella pizza needs lemon zest.
lines: The acidity cuts through the fat.
Scratch into the pith and it turns bitter.
Change a small detail, and the meaning of the whole changes.
And no, the internet didn’t tell me to.

wait.heading: WAIT WAIT WAIT
wait.body: I said it often enough that two teammates put it on a T-shirt.

nonnino.label: The nonnino
nonnino.heading: The grandpa runs so fast that when he looks behind him, he sees the avant-garde approaching.

book.label: The book
book.heading: One day I’d like to write a book.
lines: Something that can speak when I’m not there to over-explain it.
Preferably while I’m still around to complain about the reviews.
